text:
maya: Quick heads up — saw a TTFT spike for route /chat/stream on p100-dedicated this morning, kernel attribution shows weird handoff time.
arjun: link? screenshot?
maya: paste Prom panel snapshot: https://grafana.redwood/…/panel/143
liam: saw same, started at ~08:12 UTC, 8-12% tail increase on TTFT for batch size 1, decode unchanged?
maya: decode appears stable, but kernel_selector time jumped. here's the raw span dump:
perf-bot: snapshot: kernel_selector_ms=12.4, queue_ms=1.1, kernel_ms=3.2, kv_lookup_ms=7.3
sophia: kv_lookup 7.3ms is the signal — maybe cold KVCACHE misses causing sync IO in selector path.
jules: did we roll any min_batch or prefetch config yesterday?
deploy-bot: rolled infra/2026-03-15-11 (kv-prefetch-adjust) at 07:50 UTC to prod; config: prefetch_workers=2, prefetch_window_ms=30
maya: aha — matches timeline. prefetch reduction might increase synchronous lookups when selector probes model variants.
arjun: can you paste the PromQL used?
maya: Sure:
```
sum by(route, model, kernel) (rate(token_ttft_ms_sum[5m])) / sum by(route, model, kernel) (rate(token_ttft_count[5m]))
```
liam: suggestion: add instrumented micro-timer around kernel selection + prefetch path, sample 0.5% to avoid cardinality.
sophia: also tag spans with kv_cache_hit=true/false and kernel_variant. that will let us separate TTFT contribution from kv misses.
maya: I can add instrumentation patch. plan:
- add micro-timer (histogram) in selector
- add kv_hit label on selector spans
- expose per-route breakdown in /perf/token_breakdown panel
jules: do we want to rollback prefetch change meanwhile?
arjun: quick calc: if kv_lookup_ms ~7ms and request rate 200 rps at tail, rollback could cut TTFT tail by ~20-30ms for affected requests.
liam: temp rollback approved if we see >15% tail regression. who owns rollback?
maya: i'll coordinate with infra and do a canary rollback to region-us-east-1.
perf-bot: scheduled trace collection: 1000 samples across routes starting in 2m, sample_rate=0.5%, label=kvcache-investigation
deploy-bot: canary rollback job queued: job_id=rb-20260315-73
sophia: long term: we should also update kernel selection heuristic to prefer in-memory candidates when kvcache miss probability > threshold. can prototype with A/B flag.
maya: agreed. i'll open PR for instrumentation + dashboard patch, and a followup RFC for heuristic change.
jules: assign tasks?
maya: PR: #4216 (instrumentation) — i'm owner
arjun: i'll own rollback with infra
liam: i'll add Grafana panel + alert tweak
sophia: i'll draft heuristic RFC
maya: thanks — let's sync in the 30m standup if rollback or new traces change things. :thumbsup:
